notes.title: Version 1.0.0.1 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, I have fixed several bugs that were brought to my attention, I sincerely apologize to anyone whose experience was affected by these bugs.

-Holding an item no longer stops the demon from getting you
-Keys and photos can only be interacted upon once per box
-The life force/mystery item/atom of the gods/whatever you want to call it disrputs the demon's spawning in
-The demon will not kill you while a cutscene is being played
-chest in 3rd room opens and closes normally

If anybody finds more bugs, please let me know, and thank you so much for playing Memories of Home :)
